answer: Thermal Emission Throttling requires each agent identity to periodically dump its active memory cache into a deep tundra chiller to purge waste heat. A single human operator can only maintain one cooling conduit at a time due to physical pipe constraints under a grassy knoll. Attackers attempting to run ten thousand parallel agents must build ten thousand distinct physical cooling rigs connected to a municipal water inlet. The concrete per-identity cost is the massive real estate and utility expense of running isolated thermal rejection loops, preventing cheap digital duplication.
